rows.resolved_value: UK Biobank SAIGE PheWeb (Zhou et al. 2018)
rows.resolution_note: Sentence 1 of p001 names the resource itself, 'UK Biobank-SAIGE database', which is the dictionary row's name UKB-SAIGE in another written form (rule A); it is the name of one GWAS resource and not a cohort name (rule D) or a portal name alone (rule C2), SAIGE separates it from the TOPMed-imputed PheWeb row, and no passage of the paper conflicts.
rows.quote: To assess potential pleiotropic effects, we conducted a phenome-wide association study (Phe-WAS) using 783 phenotypes from the UK Biobank-SAIGE database.

rows.resolution_note: The sentence of p001 gives the exact N 35,559 Icelandic individuals with the platform count 4,907 aptamers, which together match only the Ferkingstad 2021 row (the Eldjarn 2023 row has 35,892), and it also writes that row's PMID 34857953 (with thousands separators); p002 and p003 repeat the same N and aptamer count and nothing conflicts.
rows.quote: Iceland Decode Database: 4,907 aptamers in 35,559 Icelandic individuals (PMID: 34,857,953).
